senses.example: Esta noche cenamos tortilla de patatas.
senses.exampleGloss: Tonight we are having Spanish potato omelette for dinner.

alternatives.reason: Egg-only omelette; the sense a LatAm speaker often means by tortilla.
Scrambled, not set; common on Peninsular menus.
The bar format of the same dish; useful everyday collocation.

notes: In Spain tortilla alone usually means the potato omelette; the LatAm maize flatbread sense is not taught here.
